Internal helper: the model functions' variable lists, bare or quoted

Source: R/compare.R
dot-jst_model_name_args.Rd

numeric =, categorical = and count = in jlm() and jlogistic() name variables, so under ruling R18 they take names bare or in quotes, a c() of either, each read by .jst_names_given() without evaluating a bare name (Fix Slate 22, Session 376: categorical = Region had stopped with R's own "object 'Region' not found"). A name holding names, or a computed list, is evaluated as before.

Usage

.jst_model_name_args(
  subs,
  env,
  data,
  data_name,
  example = "Age",
  default_used = FALSE
)

Arguments

subs

Named list of the arguments, unevaluated (each from substitute() in the calling function).

env

The caller's environment.

data

The data frame.

data_name

The data frame's name, for the not-found stop.

example

A variable to name in the stop's example.

default_used

Logical; passed to .jst_names_given().

Value

The same named list, each element a character vector of names or NULL when none was given.

Details

Since Session 377 also jdesc()'s, jcorr()'s and jplot()'s numeric = and count = (and jplot()'s categorical =).
